name: Ferment (Frog God Games)
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a wine grape)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one mug or container of liquid
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

The targeted drink becomes alcoholic, if it was not before, and twice as strong if it was alcoholic. It looks, tastes, and smells exactly the same as it did before.
